shared_elements: low-relief carving on a monument surface
stylized face or mask-like features (eye, brow)
dense overlapping motifs covering the field
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief carving of curvilinear, rounded motifs including discs with interior dots and mask/eye-like elements filling the field, and both use a schematic outline-and-boss convention rather than naturalistic modelling. However, A presents a legible composition of glyph-like blocks arranged in ordered columns beside a costumed figure, while B shows only a few large, isolated, ambiguous rounded forms with no comparable register or glyphic ordering, so the shared traits are generic rather than a common scheme.
